notes:
Tawny 0.1.2, a dev build. The Android APK is debug-signed, for sideloading: it installs over other debug and adb-installed builds of Tawny, not over a release-keystore build.

The release key changed in 0.1.2. Installs from before 0.1.2 trust the old key and will not take this update, so install this one by hand once (the APK on Android, the -setup.exe on Windows); later releases then arrive in the app.

Changes since the 0.1.0 dev build (b05df42):
- chore(release): tawny 0.1.2
- feat(updates)!: sign releases with a new key
- build(deps): lock the g3 crates the updater and device backend need
- fix(ui): confirm a follow once the server has it, and say errors plainly
- fix(share): copy the link where there is no share sheet
- fix(feed): lay the feed out as one grid and give scroll memory sole ownership
- feat(shell): follow mouse Back and Forward buttons through the router
- fix(player): renew native playback through the app and retry video details
- feat(device-backend): keep the library on the device and move it to a server
- feat(desktop): give the Windows app its own icon and a window-wide fullscreen
